title: Account Center UI Extension Slots

provider_tile.description: A single tile in the provider list: plain title, plain body, and an optional declared action reference.
provider_tile.claim_boundary: The tile is data, not a widget: no layout, style, size, position, or handler is accepted.

connection_detail.description: Read-only detail for one connection: plain labels and plain values.
connection_detail.claim_boundary: No raw provider payload, credential, or token is accepted in this slot.

settings_form.description: Presentation of a connector's declared settings in the host-rendered form.
settings_form.claim_boundary: The slot carries labels and declared setting references only; the host owns the form. Arbitrary layout injection is refused.

usage_card.description: Usage and quota summary for one connection, in host-rendered form.
usage_card.claim_boundary: Values are plain text; live measurement remains DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

health_status.description: Health and availability summary for one connection.
health_status.claim_boundary: Values are plain text; live probing remains DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

action_menu.description: Declared actions a connector may offer, each referenced by an opaque action reference.
action_menu.claim_boundary: An action that was not declared up front is refused; no handler, route, or callback is accepted.

claim_boundary: This is a local slot contract, not a rendering engine.
Only plain text is accepted: markup delimiters, entity ampersands, interpolation, links, and control characters are refused rather than sanitized.
Arbitrary layout injection is refused by construction: unknown and layout-bearing attribute keys are rejected, and a batch is dropped per provider rather than partially applied.
No credential, token, secret reference value, or raw provider payload is accepted in any slot. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.
